name: Tomás Ricci
summary: DevOps Engineer with 3 years of experience optimizing cloud infrastructure and automation pipelines. Specialized in container orchestration and infrastructure as code to drive system reliability and deployment velocity. Pragmatic problem solver with a solid data science background and strong Python scripting capabilities.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
experience.description: Engineered and maintained Azure-based Kubernetes (AKS) clusters supporting localization APIs, reducing infrastructure drift by 40% through declarative Terraform configurations. Implemented Prometheus and Grafana monitoring setups that decreased mean time to detect (MTTD) system anomalies from 25 minutes to under 3 minutes. Automated software delivery by building custom Python helper utilities within GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
experience.description: Optimized multi-tenant Docker container configurations on Linux hosts, improving microservice startup latency by 15%. Automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, reducing the onboarding setup time for new engineering environments from 3 days to under 45 minutes. Partnered with product teams to scale delivery systems, ensuring 99.9% uptime across production clusters.

experience.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
experience.description: Developed Python automation scripts to replace manual log-rotation and daily backup jobs on Linux servers, saving 5 engineering hours per week.
